title: Nephi concludes his prophesying
summary: Nephi concludes his prophesying and says he will speak plainly about the doctrine of Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says he is making an end of his prophesying and will speak a few words concerning the doctrine of Christ.
Nephi says he delights in plainness and that the Lord God gives light to understanding, speaking according to people's language and understanding.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi is shown speaking to an audience not otherwise visually specified.
unspecified_visual_details: Nephi's appearance, audience's appearance and size, and the setting are not specified.

narration.text: I, Nephi, make an end of my prophesying
I shall speak unto you plainly
my soul delighteth in plainness

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi refers to his beloved brethren, but their visible presence is not established.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the brethren as visibly present without further support.
Do not invent a physical setting.

title: The Lamb’s baptism
summary: Nephi recalls the prophet shown to him who would baptize the Lamb of God, and explains that the holy Lamb humbled himself and obeyed the Father by being baptized.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi recalls a prophet shown to him who should baptize the Lamb of God.
Nephi says the Lamb of God was holy and was baptized by water to fulfil all righteousness.
Nephi says the Lamb humbled himself before the Father and witnessed that he would obey the Father’s commandments.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi speaks off-screen; the baptism is recalled in narration, not narrated as occurring in the present moment.
unspecified_visual_details: The prophet's identity and appearance, the baptism's location, and the participants' appearance are not specified here.

narration.text: that prophet which the Lord showed unto me
the Lamb of God
he humbleth himself before the Father

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi describes a previously shown event; this passage does not place the baptism in the current scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not stage the baptism as a present-tense event.
Do not identify the prophet beyond what the text says.

title: The Holy Ghost descends
summary: Nephi says the Holy Ghost descended upon the baptized Lamb in the form of a dove, and explains that the Lamb set an example of the path and gate.

explicit_facts.text: After the Lamb was baptized with water, the Holy Ghost descended upon him in the form of a dove.
Nephi says the Lamb showed the straightness of the path and narrowness of the gate by setting the example.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi speaks off-screen while the descent is recounted; the path and gate are figurative teaching, not a literal landscape.
unspecified_visual_details: The location and the visible form of the Holy Ghost beyond the stated likeness to a dove are unspecified.

narration.text: the Holy Ghost descended upon him in the form of a dove

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The path and gate are figures of speech describing the way to follow.
prohibited_inventions: Do not create a literal path or gate scene.
Do not add details to the dove-like form.

title: Follow the Son
summary: Nephi recounts the Son’s invitation to follow him, the Father’s command to repent and be baptized, and the Son’s teaching about receiving the Holy Ghost and following his example.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi reports that the Son said to follow him.
Nephi reports that the Father said to repent and be baptized in the name of his Beloved Son.
Nephi reports that the Son said the baptized would receive the Holy Ghost from the Father and should follow him and do what they had seen him do.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi's reported speech can be lettered over a neutral, supported setting; the Father and Son are not described as visibly appearing.
unspecified_visual_details: The speakers' appearance and the setting are not specified.

narration.text: Follow thou me.
Repent ye, repent ye, and be baptized in the name of my Beloved Son.
follow me, and do the things which ye have seen me do.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These are voices reported by Nephi, not a description of visible appearances.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Father or Son visibly present.
Do not invent the location or the hearers.

title: Baptism and receiving the Holy Ghost
summary: Nephi teaches that those who follow the Son with real intent, repent, and are baptized will receive the Holy Ghost and praise the Holy One of Israel.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi teaches that following the Son with full purpose of heart, repenting, and being baptized leads to receiving the Holy Ghost.
Nephi says those who receive the Holy Ghost can speak with the tongue of angels and shout praises unto the Holy One of Israel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi's teaching may be presented as off-screen narration.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of the Holy Ghost, the angels, and any people receiving baptism are not described in this verse.

narration.text: with real intent
then cometh the baptism of fire and of the Holy Ghost
shout praises unto the Holy One of Israel

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse teaches baptism and the Holy Ghost; it does not narrate a particular baptism occurring.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict an unreported baptism or visible fire.
Do not portray angels as physically present based only on the phrase “tongue of angels”.

title: The Son warns against denial
summary: Nephi reports the Son warning that denying him after repentance and baptism would have been better left unknown, and the Father affirming the Son’s words and promise to those who endure.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi reports the Son’s warning about denying him after repentance, baptism, and receiving the Holy Ghost.
Nephi reports the Father saying the Beloved’s words are true and faithful, and that whoever endures to the end shall be saved.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi reports the voices off-screen; no heavenly appearance is described.
unspecified_visual_details: The speakers' appearance and the setting are unspecified.

narration.text: it would have been better for you that ye had not known me.
He that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Both statements are reported by Nephi as voices, without a described visual appearance.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Father or Son visibly appearing.
Do not show a person denying the Son; no such event is narrated.

title: The gate and the path
summary: Nephi teaches that salvation requires enduring in the Son’s example, and describes repentance and baptism as the gate into the strait and narrow path leading to eternal life.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says a person must endure to the end while following the Son’s example to be saved.
Nephi identifies repentance and baptism by water as the gate, followed by remission of sins by fire and the Holy Ghost.
Nephi describes the strait and narrow path as leading to eternal life and says those entering receive the Holy Ghost.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi's teaching may be lettered off-screen; the gate and path are figurative.
unspecified_visual_details: No literal gate, path, travelers, or physical setting is specified.

narration.text: the gate by which ye should enter is repentance and baptism by water
this strait and narrow path which leads to eternal life

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The gate and path are metaphors for the doctrine being taught.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the metaphor as a literal landscape or journey.

title: Press forward
summary: Nephi asks whether all is done after entering the path, answers no, and teaches his hearers to press forward in Christ with hope and love, feasting upon his word and enduring to the end.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says entering the path does not mean all is done and describes unshaken faith in Christ.
Nephi teaches pressing forward with steadfastness in Christ, hope, love, feasting upon Christ’s word, and enduring to the end.
Nephi reports the Father saying those who press forward will have eternal life.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi's teaching may be presented as off-screen narration.
unspecified_visual_details: The hearers and setting are not specified.

narration.text: Behold, I say unto you, Nay
press forward with a steadfastness in Christ
Ye shall have eternal life.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Father's statement is reported by Nephi; no visible appearance is described.
prohibited_inventions: Do not portray the path, feasting, or eternal life as literal events beyond the teaching.

title: The doctrine of Christ
summary: Nephi declares that this is the only way and name by which people can be saved in the kingdom of God, and concludes that this is the doctrine of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi declares there is no other way or name under heaven by which a person can be saved in the kingdom of God.
Nephi identifies the teaching as the doctrine of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost, and ends with Amen.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi's concluding words may be shown as off-screen narration.
unspecified_visual_details: The audience and setting are unspecified.

narration.text: this is the way
this is the doctrine of Christ
Amen.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse concludes Nephi's teaching in this chapter.
prohibited_inventions: Do not add a response or event after the stated Amen.
